verdict.rationale: Svelte compiles components into JavaScript that "surgically updates the DOM" directly, so the UI is made of real DOM nodes that browser devtools can inspect. A community user also notes the generated code is "pretty readable," which helps when stepping through it in the browser. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of debugging in browser devtools (element inspection, breakpoints, source maps), hands-on corroboration of the devtools debugging workflow
